rename_data_object_keys_single: rename a single key in an AtomicData object using a string key mapping
rename_data_object_keys_multiple: rename a key in an AtomicData object to multiple new keys using a list mapping
rename_data_object_keys_preserve: rename data object keys while preserving the original key by including it in the new keys list
rename_data_object_keys_missing: rename data object keys safely when the original key is missing from the data object
rename_data_object_keys_multi_task: rename a single target label into multiple task-specific keys for multi-task learning
